name: Production Agent Heartbeat Alert
description: Detects when production agent system emits heartbeat alerts

query.query: SELECT * FROM signoz_logs.logs_v2 WHERE attributes['type'] = 'heartbeat_alert' AND attributes['system'] = 'production-agent-system' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE

annotations.description: The production agent system has emitted a heartbeat alert indicating potential issues
